purpose: Test stability-plasticity mechanisms before integrating them into a continuing TNN learner.
selection_rule: Eligible arm must be non-frozen, have positive new_gain in all 8 development populations, maximum final_old deficit <= 4, and total new_gain >= 128. Among eligible arms choose smallest total old_lost, then largest minimum new_gain, then largest total new_gain, then lowest arm id. If none qualify, choose the non-frozen arm minimizing total old_lost subject to positive aggregate new_gain; mark DEVELOPMENT_GATE_FAILED and treat holdouts as exploratory only.

holdout_gate.vs_ordinary_shared_rewrite: selected total new_gain must retain at least one half of arm1 total new_gain and selected total old_lost must be at most one quarter of arm1 total old_lost
holdout_gate.vs_strict_shared_preservation: selected total new_gain must exceed arm4 total new_gain
holdout_gate.additive_preservation_vs_additive_medium: if selected arm is 10 or 11, selected total new_gain must retain at least one half of arm8 total new_gain and selected total old_lost must be at most one half of arm8 total old_lost

validation_rule: If native development selection is -1, stop the campaign as a terminal development negative and do not expose validation or confirmation. Otherwise run the selected development arm plus fixed controls on all 12 validation populations exactly once. The native holdout gate receives the native development gate bit as upstream_gate. Qualification requires upstream_gate=1 and every frozen holdout_gate condition. If a real selected arm exists but upstream_gate=0, validation may run only as exploratory evidence and its native gate is forced to fail.
confirmation_rule: Run confirmation only if the native validation gate equals 1. Pass validation_gate=1 as confirmation upstream_gate. Confirmation repeats the identical frozen holdout_gate on 12 disjoint populations; no validation outcome may alter source, thresholds, arm, controls, seeds, or budgets.
stage_binding: After the one development invocation, freeze the exact native N15_DEV_SELECTION arm/gate line and development stdout SHA256. If arm=-1, record terminal DEVELOPMENT_NO_POSITIVE_GAIN_CANDIDATE and forbid all holdout exposure. Otherwise validation must invoke exactly that frozen arm and development gate. After the one validation invocation, freeze the exact native N15_HOLDOUT_GATE line and validation stdout SHA256 before confirmation. Confirmation is admissible only when that native validation gate equals 1 and must use the same frozen selected arm. Operational parsing/freezing may not recalculate scientific metrics outside Zag.
stage_rerun_policy: Development, validation, and confirmation are separately consumed on first actual invocation regardless of outcome. No stage is retried, retuned, or rerun. Confirmation is never invoked after validation gate 0.
